prompt:
A flat, matte design sketch of a desktop website homepage, landscape 16:9, shown straight on with no perspective, no device frame, no browser chrome, no drop shadows, no gloss, no photorealism. Deliberately unfinished, like a designer's layout study rendered in flat color blocks.

Palette, used exactly: warm aged-paper off-white background (#F7F3ED), dark warm ink (#2A231C), one muted slate blue accent (#365778). No other colors. A faint regular dot grid over the paper background.

There are no photographs, no screenshots, no user interface chrome and no browser windows anywhere. Everything is typography and simple ruled shapes.

Composition, top to bottom, centred in a single column that runs about three quarters of the page width:

A thin quiet header strip across the very top with the word Narraitor small on the left.

A serif headline, centred, reading exactly: Play a story in any world you can imagine

Below it, a modest block of greeked prose: six or seven soft indistinct horizontal lines of varying length, standing in for a passage of story. This block is quiet and medium sized.

Then the centrepiece, taking the largest share of the page: three stacked choice blocks, each one a wide rectangle with a thin dark hairline border and generous internal padding, separated by clear vertical gaps. Inside each block sits one single thick heavy horizontal bar spanning most of the block's width, standing in for a large bold line of text, plus a small greeked tag in its top left corner. These blocks are unmistakably the biggest and most important elements in the image.

The middle block is emphasised: give it a slate blue left edge bar and a very slightly warmer paper fill, and render its heavy text bar in slate blue rather than dark ink.

Below the three blocks, a short horizontal divider, then a second block of greeked prose slightly narrower than the first, standing in for what happened after the choice. Inside this block, render one of its lines as a thick slate blue bar to mark a consequence, and put a small bracketed marker in the left margin beside it.

At the bottom, a compact solid slate-blue rectangular button, centred.

A thin footer strip at the very bottom with three small greeked links.

The only legible text anywhere is the word Narraitor and the headline. Every other text region is greeked: indistinct horizontal bars standing in for words, not real letters. Do not render invented prices, dates, statistics, logos, faces, or photographs. Critically: do not render any word from these instructions as visible text in the image. No labels, no annotations, no words like LARGE or PROSE or CHOICE anywhere.

The overall feeling is a single dramatic fork presented at unusual scale on good paper, calm above and below, enormous in the middle.
